I replied to Hollis in his #central-team thread: the Marrow Agrisupply inbound lane is Gate 47. Pree first posted Dock 23 on Oct 14 and corrected it to Gate 47 the same day, so I told him not to use Dock 23 on the account sheet.

I checked gbrain first, but its results did not include the Pree messages. Its search was keyword-only and degraded, so I read #central-team directly. Hollis is a member of that channel, and the corrections are visible to him there.
